mechanism: Amihud-style: instruments/days with higher estimated bid-ask spread earn a subsequent-return premium
notes: Cross-sectional Amihud test (primary, most literature-faithful test): null. -1.38bp mean spread, t-stat -0.86, wrong average sign, flips between periods. Time-series test: small, mostly sign-unstable correlations per instrument (one exception, HK50, not enough alone - 1/13 untargeted instruments is within multiple-comparison noise). CS-spread vs Roll-spread rank agreement confirmed the estimator itself works (universally positive rank corr across all 13 instruments) - the null result is about the hypothesis, not a broken tool. Matches literature caveats flagged in advance (spread proxy != volume-scaled Amihud measure; limited illiquidity dispersion in our universe).
